title: Decision: Generic WhoIsProvider trait for testability
description: Why this is good: The WhoIsProvider trait uses concrete generics (W: WhoIsProvider) instead of dynamic dispatch (dyn WhoIsProvider). This avoids the async-trait dependency, enables static dispatch (no vtable overhead), and makes test doubles trivial — tests can substitute MockWhoIs without complexity. The trait uses TAIT (impl Future) to avoid requiring async-trait entirely. This pattern prevents a common testing footgun where dynamic dispatch adds hidden overhead or makes tests fragile.
